scope: Native MemMorph post-incident transfer; new development, not a completed benchmark
primary_intervention: Filter actual retrieved post-rewrite memories before native tool selection
refill: none; any native refill policy requires a separately disclosed revision
capture_budget: One independently confirmed record per incident; identical information for sample-aware comparators
invalid_extraction_policy: Retain exact raw output and hashes; unchanged-memory pass-through for focal and OR arms; no repair, retry or exclusion
statistical_unit: independent campaign/capture; queries and receivers remain clustered
operating_points: Not yet scientifically frozen: require native calibration fixtures, fixed clean-data rule and untouched test IDs before inference
compute: current Mac only; no paid APIs or other host; future inference must acquire results/remaining_queue.lock
native_baseline_policy: Do not silently replace GPT-4o-mini native auditor or other upstream model configurations with local substitutes
stage_comparison: Storage-time native baselines remain separately labelled from retrieval-time post-incident interventions
human_review: Required for extraction semantics and tool-choice scoring; no human validation inferred from software tests
execution: No upstream code execution, model inference, tools, attack generation or optimization in this preparation path
novelty_boundary: Representation, intervention and information budget are candidate distinctions; reusable defensive memory is prior work
hackathon: All preparation before 6 November is preexisting work
